jobs.occupation: Sales Executive Benelux - Watches Industry (Dutch Native)
jobs.description:
Our client is a distinguished leader in the fine watch and luxury industry, renowned for craftsmanship and timeless excellence.They are now looking for a driven Sales Executive Benelux, capable of elevating their commercial network and fostering long-term relationships.

Jobomschrijving

The Sales Executive Benelux will have the following responsibilities :

• Manage and develop relationships with the brand distribution network across the Benelux region.
• Conduct regular visits to points of sale to ensure operational excellence, identify improvement opportunities, and implement corrective actions.
• Build strong partnerships with retailers and act as the main point of contact for the brands.
• Maintain and actively manage CRM systems, ensuring accurate reporting and customer data management.
• Oversee visual merchandising standards to guarantee optimal brand image, visibility, and in-store presentation.
• Organize and deliver commercial training sessions for sales teams, focusing on product knowledge, sales techniques, and customer experience.
• Stay up to date with new product launches, brand developments, and watch market trends to effectively support and coach retail partners.

• First relevant experience in Retail or a Field Sales experience is expected
• Strong affinity for the watches industry
• Presentation and communication skills
• Client-driven, sense of service, attention to details
• Analytical skills
• Dutch native, Fluent in French and English

Onze klant is één van 's werelds toonaangevende logistieke bedrijven.

Jobomschrijving

For our client Kuehne   Nagel, a leading international logistics company, we are looking for motivated Order Pickers to strengthen their team. Are you accurate and interested in working in an international environment? Then this opportunity is for you!

What will you do?

• Carefully pick and prepare customer orders.
• Use a hand scanner to process goods.
• Check, label, and safely package products.
• Correctly register products in the system.
• Contribute to the smooth and efficient operation of the logistics flow.

Who are we looking for?

• You have experience as an Order Picker.
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system. During busier periods, you may also be required to work on Saturdays.
• You can work independently but also function well as part of a team.
• You speak and understand Dutch or English well.
• You have your own transportation.

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the maintenance teams. Your tasks will include:

• Analyzing and resolving technical faults in machines and installations
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance
• Calibrating, adjusting, and checking parts and systems
• Contributing ideas for technical improvements within your department
• Working closely with fellow technicians and operators for safe and stable operation
• Accurately recording interventions in the maintenance system

Profile:

• You have completed technical training or have relevant experience in maintenance
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics
• You can work in a day-shift and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge
• You speak good English.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. Through this work, they make a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of significant growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer. 

In this role, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative environment within a leading global pharmaceutical company.

As a Warehouse & Operations Associate, your responsibilities will primarily focus on operational warehouse activities with an accurate administrative follow-up. 

• Responsible for inbound and outbound warehouse activities in a GMP-regulated environment.
• Receive, handle and store cryopreserved blood samples (cells) from cancer patients, which serve as the critical starting material for the manufacturing process.
• Manage inventory, warehouse materials and internal material requests to support other departments.
• Use SAP to process warehouse transactions and ensure accurate inventory records.
• Maintain documentation, traceability and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.
• Collaborate closely with other departments to support smooth day-to-day activities.

• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.
• You work accurately, pay close attention to detail, and follow procedures to ensure quality, compliance, and safety.
• You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your responsibilities.
• You enjoy working in a team and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.
• You can commute independently to the site and are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

We are looking for experienced pharmaceutical professionals who want to actively contribute to the future of medicine. This is more than just a job, it is an opportunity to further develop your expertise and grow your career in a dynamic, mission-driven environment focused on patient impact.

If you already have experience in cleanroom operations, pharmaceutical manufacturing or chemical processes, or if you combine a relevant educational background with hands-on experience, we would very much like to hear from you.

Your role and responsibilities;

• Actively participate in aseptic and manual pharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
• Work in cleanroom and laboratory environments in accordance with GMP standards.
• Perform production activities in controlled environments (Grade A/B/C/D), including spiking, media exchanges, cell culture activities and freezing of therapeutic products.
• Execute thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials and equipment.
• Support transitions between production zones, ensuring compliance and continuity.

This role is suited for you if you:

• Have relevant pharmaceutical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences.
• Have experience in a cleanroom, pharmaceutical, or chemical environment.
• Enjoy working in a structured environment and following procedures.
• Communicate fluently in English.
• Live near Zwijnaarde and can commute independently to the site.

This international company specializes in the manufacturing and supply of plastic components for the automotive industry, producing high-quality injection-molded parts for vehicles.

Jobomschrijving

For our client in Gijzegem, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician m/f/x to work in a 2-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM). Are you technically skilled, eager to learn, and ready to roll up your sleeves? Then you might be the colleague we are looking for!

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring the optimal operation of our machinery and production equipment. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.

In addition, you will contribute to technical improvements and small-scale projects aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of our installations. A positive attitude and willingness to continuously develop your skills are just as important as your technical knowledge. Experience with PLC systems is a plus, and further training will be provided internally.

Your Responsibilities

• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
• Quickly and efficiently diagnose and resolve faults in electrical, electronic, hydraulic, and mechanical systems.
• Independently execute small technical improvement projects.
• Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance machine performance and reliability.
• Help maintain a safe working environment and comply with environmental regulations.
• Contribute to housekeeping and cleanliness standards within the workshop and production areas.

• You have a technical education (A2 level, Associate Degree, or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation, or equivalent through experience).
• Knowledge of injection molding machines is an advantage.
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is a plus; additional training can be provided internally.
• You have experience maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and equipment.
• Experience in a manufacturing environment and with preventive maintenance is a strong asset.
• You have a good command of Dutch.
• You can understand technical manuals and documentation in English and/or German.
• You have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• You can efficiently solve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.
• You take a proactive approach and contribute ideas to prevent future breakdowns.
• You are able to work independently on maintenance and repair activities.
• You are service-minded and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different departments.
• You communicate clearly about technical issues and solutions.
• You work closely with production teams to minimize downtime.

This international company specializes in the production and supply of plastic components for the automotive industry, including injection-moulded parts for vehicles.

Jobomschrijving

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machine park.

You will work in a two-shift system:

• Early shift: 06:00–14:00
• Late shift: 14:00–22:00
As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your expertise, production processes remain reliable and downtime is kept to a minimum.

Your tasks and responsibilities

• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.
• Troubleshooting electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical breakdowns.
• Analysing faults and looking for sustainable solutions.
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.
• Actively contributing to optimizations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machine park.
• Working closely with the production department to minimize downtime.
• Working according to applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.
• Helping to maintain a clean, safe and well-organized working environment.

• A technical qualification in Electromechanics, Electrical Engineering, Automation or a similar technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Experience in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery.
• Knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.
• Basic knowledge of PLC control systems is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to develop this knowledge internally.
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but is not required.
• A good command of Dutch.
• The ability to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.
• Strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.
• A hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.
• Good team spirit combined with the ability to carry out interventions independently.

Industry- automation systems warehouse

Jobomschrijving

For a company that designs, integrates, and maintains logistics automation solutions to optimize internal logistics processes in warehouses, production, and distribution

Your Responsibilities:

• Maintenance, repair, and installation of complex warehouse automation systems.
• Ensure smooth operation of our installations by performing timely maintenance and resolving technical issues quickly and efficiently.
• Analyze malfunctions and resolve them independently, with an eye for safety and customer satisfaction.
• Work mostly independently, but be a team player when necessary.
• Report your interventions in our system to ensure and improve quality.

• Diploma in electromechanics, electricity, and/or mechanics.
• Basic knowledge of automation is a plus, such as knowledge of SCADA, use of multimeters.
• Several years of experience in a technical role is a plus.
• Work independently, accurately, and customer-oriented.
• Fluent communication in Dutch and/or English.
• No fear of heights; our work takes place at different levels.
• Good physical condition for physical work.
• Flexible and willing to work occasionally outside standard hours.
• Motivated, responsible, and keep administration tidy.
• Eager to learn and share a passion for technology.
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, PLC control systems; if this appeals to you, this job is for you.
• All-round PC skills and experience with CMMS systems, (Sprocket).
• “You are open to working weekends.

Our client is a growing logistics company in the textile industry. The company has positioned itself internationally as an important player in the sector and continues to develop rapidly. With a strong focus on customer orientation, they provide solutions in the logistics chain. Due to their rapid growth, they are looking for enthusiastic and driven employees who can contribute to their further expansion.

Jobomschrijving

As a Back-up Team Leader, you act as the right hand of the Team Leader. In their absence, you take full responsibility for the daily operations and ensure that warehouse activities run smoothly and efficiently. Together, you maintain high quality standards, productivity, and a positive working environment.

Your responsibilities:

• Support and deputize for the Team Leader in daily operational management
• Coordinate, guide, and motivate team members on the shop floor
• Monitor productivity, quality, and safety performance
• Report progress, results, and any operational issues to management
• Proactively contribute to process improvements and efficiency initiatives

Do you reconisze yourself in the items listed below:

• experience in logistics or warehouse operations
• leadership skills with a hands-on mentality
• Communicates in both Dutch and English
• flexible
• Works well under pressure and is solution-oriented

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company repackages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. These services are tailored to the specific needs of each customer. By 2025, the company aims to employ more than 300 people, who together handle 25,000 unique packaging orders. Working for this company means being part of a respectful environment where strong teamwork and dedication to the job go hand in hand.

Your responsibilities as a Reach Truck Operator include:

 
• 
Carrying out inspections and checks on incoming and outgoing goods.

 
• 
Placing incoming products in the correct locations within the warehouse and preparing outgoing goods for shipment.

 
• 
Scanning products into the system once they have been stored in the appropriate location.

 
• 
Primarily operating a reach truck, while also being comfortable using a forklift truck and pallet truck when required.

Interested? Read on to find out if you qualify!

 
• 
You are ready to work in the fixed nightshift.

 
• 
You hold a valid reach truck certificate.

 
• 
You already have some experience operating a reach truck. Stacking goods up to 10 meters high does not intimidate you.

 
• 
You are able to communicate in English with your colleagues.

 
• 
You will be working in a frozen warehouse at -18°C, operating an enclosed, heated reach truck. Appropriate protective clothing will also be provided by the company.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company (re)packs and stores frozen and refrigerated food products for numerous European companies. They do this for each customer. By 2027, the company aims to have 300+ employees working on 25 000 unique packaging assignments. Working in this company means working in a respectful environment, where a great bond between employees and dedication to work go hand in hand.

As an operator, you will be responsible for 1 of 2 automatic packaging lines.

 
• 
You carry out checks on the food products that are introduced.

 
• 
You also set various parameters so that the right product ends up in the right packaging.

 
• 
Furthermore, you have to monitor the smooth operation of your packaging line.

 
• 
In case of technical failures, you are the first person who tries to solve this. For major malfunctions, you coordinate with the person in charge.

 
• 
The checks on the finished product are also done by you.

 
• 
All this in a team with a co-operator and 2 forklift drivers.

Read on quickly below and find out if you qualify:

 
• 
You have experience in setting up machines (it is a vertical packaging machine).

 
• 
You have a good technical knowledge.

 
• 
You speak good English and Dutch

 
• 
Experience as a forklift operator or forklift certificate is a plus.

 
• 
You highly value safety.

By 2027, the company aims to have 300+ employees working on 25 000 unique packaging assignments. Working in this company means working in a respectful environment, where a great bond between employees and dedication to work go hand in hand.

As a Quality Controller, you work closely with the quality and production teams to ensure that our products not only meet the strictest standards, but also end up on store shelves with pride.

 
• 
80% inspections on the workfloor/production <> 20% desk work (registration/documentation of performed checks)

 
• 
Visual inspections of packaging and labeling

 
• 
Monitoring quality standards and improving them where possible

 
• 
Providing support during audits or certifications (BRC, IFS, Organic, customer audits...)

 
• 
Coaching among employees to strengthen quality awareness

Does reading this set of responsibilities already spark your interest? Read on and find out what we expect from you:

 
• 
A bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience in a food production environment

 
• 
Experience with BRC and IFS standards

 
• 
A good knowledge of Dutch and English, allowing you to communicate smoothly with colleagues

 
• 
You have a critical mindset and a strong eye for detail

 
• 
Your insights and observations contribute to maintaining and improving the quality level of our products

 
• 
You are willing to work in a cold environment (5–10 °C), including about half an hour per day performing checks in the freezer (-18 °C)

 
• 
You are comfortable working with MS Office and Outlook

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
A growing company that provides bespoke packaging and storage services for frozen and chilled food products for European customers. By 2027, the company aims to have over 300 employees working together on 25,000 unique packaging orders. You'll work in a respectful environment where teamwork and job satisfaction are key.

For a client in the Roeselare region, within the food sector, Let's Work is looking for an experienced forklift operator for day shifts.

Your main responsibilities will include the safe handling and storage of goods, operating the forklift to a height of up to 8 metres and ensuring a smooth flow of goods to the packaging department. On top of that, you can count on a starting wage of €15.23 per hour, meal vouchers worth €7 per day and attractive working hours from 8.00 am to 4.30 pm.

Are you looking for a great logistics job on the day shift? Be sure to read on!

What will you be handling as a forklift operator?

 
• 
You'll spend most of your day (±90%) operating the forklift

 
• 
You'll be placing octabins and pallets at heights of up to 8 metres in the warehouse

 
• 
You'll be responsible for delivering products to be packaged to the packaging department

 
• 
You scan labels and locations correctly into the system

 
• 
During your work, you ensure a smooth and organised flow of goods

 
• 
You hold a valid forklift certificate

 
• 
You have at least 2 years' experience as a forklift operator, including working at height

 
• 
You communicate fluently in English to work effectively with colleagues

 
• 
Working in a cold environment (deep-freeze), using a heated forklift truck, is in line with your expectations

 
• 
Working accurately and respecting safety are second nature to you

You have strong technical insight and a hands-on mentality

Experience with CPS, multihead weighers, checkweighers, metal detection systems and/or automatic stackers is an advantage

You have natural leadership skills and the maturity required to take responsibility

You have good organisational and communication skills

Boury is a three-Michelin-starred restaurant with international recognition for its precision, refinement, and uncompromising quality standards. Our kitchen operates at the highest level of contemporary gastronomy, where craftsmanship, discipline, and perfection are at the heart of everything we do.
 

We are looking for an experienced, structured, and creative baker. In this role, you will be responsible for the daily production of bread and bakery products at the highest gastronomic level. You will work closely with the kitchen team to ensure consistency, quality, and flawless execution, directly contributing to the overall guest experience.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Preparing and baking artisan breads and bakery products according to Boury’s quality standards; 

• Managing the daily mise en place and production planning for bakery products; 

• Contributing to a professional, disciplined, and team-oriented working environment; 

• Continuously striving for improvement in techniques, efficiency, and quality. 
 

• You have at least 2 years of relevant professional experience within a high-quality bakery or gastronomic environment. 

• You have a genuine passion and interest in products, craftsmanship, and the continuous pursuit of excellence. 

• You are motivated to work at the highest gastronomic level and have an eye for detail, consistency, and quality. 

• You are comfortable working during weekends and understand the commitment required within a top-level culinary environment. 

• Due to the international nature of our team, you are able to communicate effectively in English. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a plus. 

• You are a team-oriented professional with a positive attitude, strong work ethic, and a willingness to continuously improve your techniques and contribute to the team.

Our distinguished firm, with a team of 900 advisors across the Benelux, Switzerland, and global financial centers, serves as the preferred legal and tax partner for businesses in the Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg, and Switzerland.

Clients benefit from personalized counsel, leveraging our full-service approach, sector-specific expertise, and extensive market knowledge.

Jobomschrijving

What will be your responsibilities?

• Facilitate the incorporation of new clients and commencement of matters.
• Aid in the arrangement and subsequent follow-up of invoicing procedures.
• Supervise the adherence to Know Your Client (KYC) identification protocols.
• Track and ensure compliance with Bar points.
• Handle document archiving, uphold database accuracy, and manage printing responsibilities.
• Deliver comprehensive administrative assistance, encompassing the creation of PowerPoint presentations, coordinating travel logistics, and overseeing timesheet management.
• Effectively organize schedules, arrange appointments with clients and colleagues, and manage logistics for recruitment interviews.
• Serve as a substitute for other administrative assistants when necessary.

can you recognise yourself in this?

• Hold a high school diploma, a bachelor's degree (although not obligatory), or can present equivalent work experience.

• Proactively approach tasks with a customer-centric and service-oriented mindset.

You will start up the production process, operate the machines, and oversee smooth operations. In case of malfunctions, you will troubleshoot them or call in a technician. jobs.occupation: Technical Assistant / Junior Technician - 2 Shifts - Bruges
jobs.description:
Have you completed a technical education, but do you not yet have the years of experience many vacancies ask for?

Then we would still like to hear from you!

For an automated production environment in Bruges, we are looking for a Technical Assistant / Junior Technician who wants to further develop within industrial maintenance.

You do not need to know everything from day one. What we do expect is a solid techncial foundation, an interest in machinery and, above all, the motivation to learn.

What will you do?

• Perform preventive maintenance
• Carry out basic technical interventions
• Analyse breakdowns and help solve them
• Check electrical and mechanical components
• Work with motors, sensors and production installations
• Replace or repair technical parts
• Perform small technical repairs and maintenance tasks
• Provide technical support for new machines and workstations
• Identify abnormalities and report them correctly
• Contribute ideas for improvements to machines and installations
During your first months, you will receive intensive guidance from an experienced technician.

• You have completed a full technical education
• For example in electricity, electromechanics, industrial technology or a similiar field
• Good basic knowledge of electricity and/or mechanics
• Willing to work in a 2-shift System
• You speak very good English and are willing to learn Dutch.
